text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts on /v1/generate (us-west-2). 5xx rate = 12% over 5m, p95=2.1s, p99=12.3s. Paging @bob_oncall

bob_oncall: oncall here, investigating. pulling gateway + scheduler logs now

alice_sre: seeing a sharp queue depth increase in the batcher — backlog spiked ~09:23 UTC. looks like head-of-line blocking, many batches stuck waiting

carol_runtime: confirming — one long-running request (seq len ~32000, rerank job) held a GPU slot and its KV cache lock for ~28s. Batcher uses in-order grouping so others behind it starved -> backlog

bob_oncall: ok that matches gateway 504s. any quick mitigation we can toggle?

frank_enginfra: we can flip adaptive-batching off per-cluster or route traffic to fallback pool. recommended immediate: disable adaptive batching on prod gateway and spin up 2 extra workers in dedicated pool

bob_oncall: doing disable now. patching flag:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.internal/flags" -d '{"adaptive_batching": false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

incident-bot: Flag change applied (flag-service). autoscale job started for pool:dedicated-usw2-1 (requested +2 workers)

alice_sre: also enabling preemptive KV eviction for current batcher instance to free long-held locks: running one-off script
```bash
redwoodctl jobs run --cluster=prod-usw2 --script=evict-old-kv.sh
```

carol_runtime: I'm adding a temporary routing rule to divert 20% traffic to model-variant:lite (lower throughput but shorter tail latency)

dan_support: customer impact: three enterprise tenants (acme-inc, beta-app, finance-x) reported errors at 09:22-09:30 UTC. creating support notes and opening tickets.

eve_prod: prepping a short status page update: brief summary + ETA for mitigation. keep wording conservative.

bob_oncall: after flag flip and extra workers request, error rate dropped to 4% within 90s, p99 down to 3.2s. still above baseline but improving

frank_enginfra: workers are coming up — 2 new workers healthy in pool dedicated-usw2-1. routing confirmed.

alice_sre: backlog draining but some batches still stuck due to in-flight locks. eviction job finished, freed 7 locks.

carol_runtime: routing rule live. diversion is taking load off main pool.

bob_oncall: good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. handing to alice for deeper root cause and follow-ups. handing off @alice_sre :white_check_mark:

alice_sre: taking over. timeline notes: 09:20 alert triggered by sudden long-tail rerank request -> 09:22 batcher backlog climbs -> 09:23 gateway 504s -> 09:24 flag flip + eviction job -> 09:26 autoscale + routing -> 09:28 error rate falling

dan_support: logged customer tickets and sent initial email to affected customers. Sarah@acme replied asking for root cause and mitigation steps.

eve_prod: status page posted (minor outage). link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1832501234

frank_enginfra: quick note: our in-order batching algorithm makes us vulnerable to HOL when a single request holds resources long. we need a rate limiter or per-request preemption path

alice_sre: agreed. initial RCA draft: interplay of long-tail sequence rerank + adaptive batching in in-order mode -> head-of-line blocking -> queue saturation -> gateway timeouts. Secondary contributor: autoscaling lag of ~90s before extra workers available.

carol_runtime: possible fixes: 1) preemptible slots for long-running requests 2) enable per-request priority/timeout 3) fall back to small-batch path when waiting >X ms 4) change KV lock granularity

bob_oncall: any quick postmortem tasks I should include before I sign off?

alice_sre: capture logs and the offending request id(s), add a test that simulates long-seq rerank to validate preemption, and add an autoscale fast-path for HOL scenarios. also add alert for batcher queue depth crossing X for >30s

dan_support: follow-ups: reach out to affected customers with RCA when ready, offer assisted retries/migrations for critical tenants.

eve_prod: schedule a cross-team post-incident at 16:00 UTC to decide the prioritized mitigation list.

frank_enginfra: I'll own the autoscale fast-path prototype. expected ETA for PR: 1 week.

alice_sre: I'll draft full RCA and proposed mitigations. PRs for short-term fixes: change batcher to allow small-batch draining and preemption (owners: carol_runtime + frank_enginfra).

carol_runtime: creating issue for KV lock granularity and small-batch fallback. assigning labels: priority/high, incident-linked:1832501234

bob_oncall: leaving the channel, will check back in morning. thanks all. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> under monitoring. Pager cleared for on-call.

alice_sre: final note: root cause = head-of-line blocking inside batcher caused by a long-running rerank request holding a GPU slot + KV lock; they triggered queue buildup and gateway 5xxs. Recovery actions taken: disable adaptive batching, KV eviction, short-term autoscale, traffic diversion. Action items created.

carol_runtime: adding retrospective doc link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/infra/1832501234-postmortem

dan_support: closing customer tickets as resolved if no further errors in 2h.

frank_enginfra: :white_check_mark: I'll follow up with a design doc for preemption and autoscale fast-path.

eve_prod: thanks team. sending out post-incident summary to execs and affected customers after RCA complete. :email:
